title: Insurance Between Firms: The Role of Internal Labor Markets
title_primary: Insurance Between Firms: The Role of Internal Labor Markets
authors: Giacinta Cestone, Chiara Fumagalli, Francis Kramarz, Giovanni Pica, Michael Ewens 等
official: 官方在线 2016-06-17 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We investigate how internal labor markets (ILMs) allow business groups to accommodate positive and negative shocks calling for labor adjustments. Group-affiliated units faced with positive shocks rely on the ILM for new hires, especially managers and other high-skilled workers, thus overcoming human capital bottlenecks that may curb growth. Adverse shocks affecting one unit in the organization increase workers' mobility to other units rather than external firms, with stricter employment protection causing an additional increase in internal mobility. ILMs emerge as a co-insurance mechanism, allowing organizations to bypass firing and hiring frictions and providing job stability to employees as a by-product.

title: World agricultural prices and the outbreak of civil war

abstract: Falling agricultural prices have been found to generally increase armed civil conflict in producing regions, but not the risk of the most lethal conflicts – civil wars. This column shows that the evidence for civil-war onset is consistent with the broader evidence on armed civil conflict when agricultural price indices isolate changes in world prices from changes in countries’ exports. Across 118 countries over 1957–2007, a one standard deviation decline in world agricultural prices raised the risk of civil-war onset by around 30%, with larger effects in sub-Saharan Africa. The evidence points to falling producer incomes, rather than rising consumer food prices, as the mechanism.

title: Designing AI-Augmented Peer Review

official: 官方在线 2026-08-31 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: AI-generated assessments of manuscripts could improve the quality of peer review, but sharing them with reviewers might decrease the information that editors possess about the manuscript. Human peer reviews add value because reviewers add what the AI assessment reveals. When both reviewers see the same assessment and make similar errors, they can replicate each other’s mistakes, coincidentally investigate related areas, and share the same blind spots. If AI assessment improves the quality of reviewers’ work while they investigate the manuscript, giving the report to only one reviewer can better combine AI assistance with independent, human investigation. If some reviewers already use AI-generated assessments on their own, changing the journal policy to allow sharing the assessment can improve peer review if the change takes some of the burden of investigation off private tools that make similar errors, though giving the assessment to only one reviewer may still outperform giving it to both or neither. Even a report delivered after the reviews are submitted can still shift what reviewers investigate if they know in advance which issues it will check. Journal policy will depend on the AI’s effects on reviewer effort and the questions they investigate, whether reviewers are willing and able to comply with the policy, the monitoring costs, and the journal’s ability to protect the confidentiality of reviewer identities and emails. Journals can evaluate competing policies without knowing the true quality of the manuscripts they review by randomly varying who receives the assessment and then comparing reviewer disagreement across different levels of report sharing.
abstract_zh: AI生成的稿件评估有望提升同行评审质量，但将其分享给评审人可能会减少编辑所掌握的稿件信息。人工同行评审之所以具有价值，是因为评审人能够补充AI评估所揭示的内容。当两位评审人看到相同的评估并犯下相似错误时，他们可能重复彼此的失误，巧合地探究相关领域，并共享相同的盲点。如果AI评估在评审人调查稿件期间能提升其工作质量，那么仅将报告提供给一位评审人，可以更好地将AI辅助与独立的人工调查相结合。若部分评审人已自行使用AI生成的评估，改变期刊政策以允许分享评估，可在一定程度上减轻私人工具（这些工具可能产生类似错误）的调查负担，从而改善同行评审，尽管仅向一位评审人提供评估可能仍优于向两位或都不提供。即使在评审意见提交后才送达的报告，若评审人预先知晓其将核查哪些问题，仍可能改变他们的调查方向。期刊政策将取决于AI对评审人努力程度及其调查问题的影响、评审人是否愿意且能够遵守政策、监控成本，以及期刊保护评审人身份和电子邮件机密性的能力。期刊可通过随机分配谁接收评估，并比较不同报告分享水平下评审人之间的分歧，来评估竞争性政策，而无需知晓其所评审稿件的真实质量。

title: On voting rules satisfying false-name-proofness and participation
title_zh: 关于满足假名防伪性与参与性的投票规则
title_primary: 关于满足假名防伪性与参与性的投票规则
title_secondary: On voting rules satisfying false-name-proofness and participation
official: 官方在线 2026-08-27 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We consider voting rules in settings where voters’ identities are difficult to verify. Voters can manipulate the process by casting multiple votes under different identities or abstaining from voting. Immunities to such manipulations are called false-name-proofness and participation, respectively. For the universal domain of (strict) preferences, these properties together imply anonymity and are incompatible with neutrality. For the domain of preferences defined over all subsets of a given set of objects, both false-name-proofness and participation cannot be met by rules that are also onto, object neutral, and tops-only. However, when preferences over subsets of objects are restricted to be separable, all these properties can be satisfied. Furthermore, the domain of separable preferences is maximal for these properties.
abstract_zh: 我们考察在选民身份难以验证的环境下的投票规则。选民可能通过以不同身份投多票或弃权来操纵过程。对此类操纵的免疫性分别称为虚假身份证明性和参与性。在（严格）偏好的全域上，这些性质共同蕴含匿名性，并与中立性不相容。在定义于给定对象集所有子集上的偏好域中，虚假身份证明性和参与性无法由同时满足满射性、对象中立性和仅依赖顶点的规则实现。然而，当对对象子集的偏好被限制为可分离时，所有这些性质均可满足。此外，可分离偏好域对于这些性质而言是最大的。

abstract: The rapid diffusion of generative AI has revived fears that a new wave of automation will inevitably shift income away from workers. This column uses data covering nearly the universe of French firms between 1994 and 2019 to test the relationship between automation and the labour share of income at the firm level. While firms clearly automated extensively over this period, the evidence shows that it can profoundly reshape jobs and production without necessarily shifting income from labour to capital.

title: Fiscal Distress and Banking Performance: The Role of Macroprudential Regulation

title_primary: 财政困境与银行业绩：宏观审慎监管的作用

authors: HIONA BALFOUSSIA, HARRIS DELLAS, DIMITRIS PAPAGEORGIOU
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2026-07-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Fiscal fragility undermines a government's ability to honor its bank deposit insurance pledge and induces a positive correlation between sovereign default risk and financial (bank) default risk. We show that this positive relation is reversed if bank capital requirements in fiscally weak countries are allowed to adjust optimally. The resulting higher requirements buttress the banking system and support higher output and welfare relative to the case where macroprudential policy does not vary with the degree of fiscal stress. Fiscal tenuousness also exacerbates the effects of other risk shocks. Nonetheless, the economy's response can be mitigated if macroprudential policy is adjusted optimally.
abstract_zh: 财政脆弱性削弱了政府履行银行存款保险承诺的能力，并导致主权违约风险与金融（银行）违约风险之间呈现正相关关系。我们证明，若允许财政薄弱国家的银行资本要求进行最优调整，这种正相关关系将发生逆转。相较于宏观审慎政策不随财政压力程度变化的情形，由此产生的更高资本要求能够强化银行体系，并支撑更高的产出与福利水平。财政脆弱性还会加剧其他风险冲击的影响。然而，若对宏观审慎政策进行最优调整，经济对此类冲击的反应可得到缓解。

title: Climate change and complexity: Accounting for singularities in environmental dynamics
title_zh: 气候变化与复杂性：环境动态中奇异性的考量
title_primary: 气候变化与复杂性：环境动态中奇异性的考量
title_secondary: Climate change and complexity: Accounting for singularities in environmental dynamics
authors: D. La Torre, Simone Marsiglio, Franklin Mendivil, F. Privileggi
official: 官方在线 2026-07-24 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The complexity of climate change and environmental dynamics requires us to account for the possibility of singularities in the occurrence of future events. Abrupt and disruptive phenomena, often associated with extreme or catastrophic processes, provide clear examples of why singularities may be relevant for policymaking when designing appropriate control measures. However, the classical theory of differential equations and thus of dynamic optimization does not apply when environmental complexity implies that the source of the temporal variation in a state variable is singular with respect to the Lebesgue measure. In this paper we thus develop a theory of dynamic optimization capable to handling singularities (i) by defining a suitable differential equation (based on a new concept of derivative with respect to an abstract measure) describing singular dynamics, and (ii) by following the calculus of variations approach to establish first-order type necessary conditions for an optimization problem in which the dynamic constraint is characterized by singularity properties. We present an economic application in the context of climate change in which the social planner aims at minimizing the social cost of adaptation over a finite time-horizon in the case in which the cumulative damages are highly irregular and concentrated. We show how our theory can effectively be used to determine the optimal policy response in such a complex framework and thus how it can support policymakers to effectively account for the presence of eventual singularities in environmental dynamics.
abstract_zh: 气候变化与环境动态的复杂性要求我们在考虑未来事件发生时，必须考虑到奇点存在的可能性。突发的、破坏性的现象，往往与极端或灾难性过程相关联，为奇点为何可能对政策制定在设计适当控制措施时具有重要意义提供了明确例证。然而，当环境复杂性意味着状态变量时间变化的来源相对于勒贝格测度是奇异的时，经典的微分方程理论及随之而来的动态优化理论便不再适用。因此，本文发展了一种能够处理奇点的动态优化理论，具体做法包括：（i）通过定义一个合适的微分方程（基于一种关于抽象测度的新导数概念）来描述奇异动态；（ii）遵循变分法的方法，为动态约束具有奇点特性的优化问题建立一阶必要条件的类型。我们在气候变化的背景下提出了一个经济应用，其中社会规划者旨在有限时间范围内最小化适应成本的社会成本，且累积损害高度不规则且集中。我们展示了我们的理论如何有效地用于确定在这种复杂框架下的最优政策响应，从而支持政策制定者有效考虑环境动态中可能存在的奇点。

title: Omitted instrument bias
title_zh: 遗漏工具变量偏误
title_primary: 遗漏工具变量偏误
title_secondary: Omitted instrument bias
official: 官方在线 2026-07-21 · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: Researchers often have access to multiple instrumental variables for a single treatment, yet empirical practice frequently relies on only one instrument while ignoring the others. We show that this approach generally identifies a noncausal parameter. We characterize the resulting “omitted-instrument bias” and show that it vanishes in special cases, such as when instruments are independent of each other or treatment effects are homogeneous. We propose a simple alternative two-stage least squares specification that identifies a causal estimand.
abstract_zh: 研究者们常常拥有针对单一处理变量的多个工具变量，然而实证操作中往往仅依赖其中一个而忽略其余。我们证明，这种做法通常识别出的并非因果参数。我们刻画了由此产生的“遗漏工具变量偏误”，并指出在特定情形下，如工具变量相互独立或处理效应同质时，该偏误会消失。我们提出一种简单的替代两阶段最小二乘设定，能够识别出因果估计量。

title: Work Intensity and Welfare Across Countries and Over Time
title_zh: 跨国与跨时期的工作强度与福利
title_primary: 跨国与跨时期的工作强度与福利
title_secondary: Work Intensity and Welfare Across Countries and Over Time
authors: Francisco Alcalá, Margherita Borella, Mariacristina De Nardi, Fang Yang, Johanna Torres Chain 等
official: 官方在线 2025-10-02 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper develops a long-run theory of labor effort, defined as the product of hours worked times work intensity. Under empirically plausible parameter values, the model predicts that intensity rises with income as hours decline. The theory provides a unified interpretation of several empirical regularities: cross-country disparities in hourly productivity among workers with comparable skills and technologies; higher workplace stress in richer economies; limited effectiveness of work-organization reforms in poor regions; patterns of non-work at work. The model is calibrated to match the large joint shift in hours and work intensity in the United States during the first half of the twentieth century. It shows that cross-country differences in intensity matter for welfare as much as differences in hours and suggests that accounting for intensity would significantly narrow measured welfare differences between rich and poor countries. The analysis identifies a key mechanism underlying the reorganization of work and leisure during the transition from poor traditional economies to affluent industrial ones.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个关于劳动努力的长期理论，将劳动努力定义为工作时间与工作强度的乘积。在经验上合理的参数取值下，模型预测工作强度随收入上升而增加，而工作时间则随之下降。该理论为若干经验规律提供了统一解释：技能与技术条件相似的劳动者在小时生产率上存在的跨国差异；富裕经济体中更高的工作场所压力；贫困地区工作组织改革的有限成效；以及“在职非工作”的行为模式。模型经过校准，以匹配20世纪上半叶美国工作时间和工作强度的大幅联合变动。研究表明，跨国工作强度差异对福利的影响与工作时间差异同等重要，并指出若将工作强度纳入考量，将显著缩小富国与穷国之间测度上的福利差距。分析揭示了从贫困传统经济向富裕工业经济转型过程中，工作与休闲重组背后的关键机制。

abstract: Attracting and retaining effective teachers in high-poverty schools remains a persistent challenge. We evaluate the impact of an initiative that offered substantial performance-based compensation to highly effective teachers in the lowest-achieving schools. We find that the program led to dramatic improvements in achievement, nearly closing the gap between the targeted schools and the district average. When the program was later reversed for some campuses, effective teachers departed at high rates, resulting in an immediate decline in student achievement. The results underscore the potential for effectiveness-based compensating differentials to attract and retain effective teachers in disadvantaged schools.
abstract_zh: 在贫困率较高的学校中吸引并留住高效教师仍是一项长期挑战。我们评估了一项针对成绩最差学校中高效教师提供高额绩效薪酬的举措。研究发现，该项目显著提升了学生学业成绩，几乎弥合了目标学校与学区平均水平之间的差距。当该项目后来在部分学校被取消时，高效教师大量流失，导致学生成绩立即下滑。研究结果凸显了基于教学效能的薪酬差异在吸引和留住弱势学校高效教师方面的潜力。

title: The Benefits from Bundling Demand in K-12 Broadband Procurement
title_zh: K-12宽带采购中捆绑需求带来的收益
title_primary: K-12宽带采购中捆绑需求带来的收益
title_secondary: The Benefits from Bundling Demand in K-12 Broadband Procurement
authors: Aryal, Gaurab, Pal, Pallavi, Murry, Charles, Palit, Arnab
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We study a new market design for K-12 broadband procurement that switched from school-specific bidding to a system that bundled schools into groups. Using an event study approach, we estimate that this program reduced internet prices by $9.17 (55%) per Mbps per month while increasing bandwidth by 380.06 Mbps (136%). These benefits resulted primarily from mitigating exposure risk—the possibility that providers win too few contracts to cover their fixed infrastructure costs. We document participants’ potential savings of $1.61–$3.48 million relative to their $2.47 million E-rate subsidy.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一种面向K-12宽带采购的新市场设计，该设计将原本按学校单独招标的模式转变为将学校捆绑成组的系统。通过事件研究方法，我们估计该计划使每Mbps月均互联网价格降低了9.17美元（降幅55%），同时带宽增加了380.06 Mbps（增幅136%）。这些收益主要源于缓解了暴露风险——即供应商可能因赢得合同数量过少而无法覆盖其固定基础设施成本的可能性。我们记录到，参与者相对于其247万美元的E-rate补贴，潜在节省金额为161万至348万美元。

title: Opening the black box of Europe’s new fiscal rules
title_zh: 揭开欧洲新财政规则的黑箱
title_primary: 揭开欧洲新财政规则的黑箱
title_secondary: Opening the black box of Europe’s new fiscal rules
official: 官方在线 2026-07-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The EU's fiscal rules in force since 2024 are often criticised for their complexity. The official implementation requires thousands of lines of code and a sophisticated debt sustainability analysis. This column argues that the central result can be approximated by a remarkably simple formula: the required primary balance equals the largest debt-stabilising primary balance in a ten-year period plus roughly 1% of the debt ratio. While this simplification cannot replace the full calculations, it helps demystify the debt rules and provides a shortcut for assessing the impact of policies on debt sustainability.
abstract_zh: 自2024年起生效的欧盟财政规则常因其复杂性而受到批评。官方实施需要数千行代码和复杂的债务可持续性分析。本文认为，其核心结果可通过一个极为简单的公式近似得出：所需的基本财政余额等于十年期内最大的债务稳定基本余额加上约1%的债务比率。尽管这一简化无法替代完整计算，但它有助于揭开债务规则的神秘面纱，并为评估政策对债务可持续性的影响提供了一条捷径。

title: Identifying News Shocks From Forecasts
title_zh: 从预测中识别新闻冲击
title_primary: 从预测中识别新闻冲击
title_secondary: Identifying News Shocks From Forecasts
official: 官方在线 2026-07-09 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We propose a method to identify the anticipated components of macroeconomic shocks in a structural VAR. We include empirical forecasts about each time series in the VAR. This introduces enough linear restrictions to identify every structural shock and to further decompose each one into “news” and “surprise” shocks. We estimate a VAR on U.S. time series using forecast data from the SPF, CBO, Federal Reserve, and asset prices. Unanticipated fiscal stimulus and monetary policy shocks have typical effects that match existing evidence. In our news‐surprise decomposition, we find that news drives around one quarter of U.S. business cycle volatility. News explains a larger share of the variance due to fiscal shocks than for monetary policy shocks. Finally, we use the news structure of the shocks to estimate counterfactual policy rules, and compare the ability of fiscal and monetary policy to moderate output and inflation. We find that coordinated fiscal and monetary policy are substantially more effective than either individually.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文提出一种在结构向量自回归（VAR）中识别宏观经济冲击预期成分的方法。我们将各时间序列的经验预测纳入VAR模型，由此引入足够的线性约束，从而识别所有结构性冲击，并进一步将每个冲击分解为“新闻”冲击与“意外”冲击。我们利用美国国会预算办公室（CBO）、美联储、资产价格及专业预测者调查（SPF）的预测数据，对美国时间序列进行VAR估计。研究发现，未预期的财政刺激与货币政策冲击的典型效应与既有证据一致。在新闻-意外分解中，新闻冲击解释了美国经济周期波动约四分之一的方差。相较于货币政策冲击，新闻冲击对财政冲击方差的解释份额更大。最后，我们利用冲击的新闻结构估计反事实政策规则，并比较财政政策与货币政策在平抑产出与通胀方面的效力。结果表明，财政与货币政策的协调配合比单一政策显著更有效。

title: Racial Disparities in Education During and Following the Pandemic: Evidence in Connecticut through 2025
title_zh: 疫情期间及之后教育中的种族差异：基于康涅狄格州截至2025年的证据
title_primary: 疫情期间及之后教育中的种族差异：基于康涅狄格州截至2025年的证据
title_secondary: Racial Disparities in Education During and Following the Pandemic: Evidence in Connecticut through 2025
authors: Eric Brunner, Stephen Ross, Xinrui Wang
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We examine pandemic related racial and ethnic disparities in test scores, absenteeism, and disciplinary incidents for K-12 students in the State of Connecticut through the 2024-25 school year. Notably, most existing pandemic studies only cover absenteeism through 2022-23, and minimal quantitative evidence exists on the post-pandemic incidence of student discipline related behaviors. Consistent with prior studies, we find persistent negative effects of the pandemic on test scores, as well as substantial disparities in test scores along racial and ethnic lines. For middle school, we also find persistent post-pandemic increases in both severe disciplinary incidents overall and racial and ethnic disparities in severe discipline incidents. However, we document substantial recovery in racial and ethnic disparities in attendance rates and chronic absenteeism by 2024-25. For all outcomes, most of the increases in disparities are associated with Black and Latinx students attending schools that had worse pre-pandemic outcomes and higher pre-pandemic shares of students who are either economically disadvantaged or face learning barriers.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了康涅狄格州K-12学生截至2024-25学年的疫情相关种族与族裔差异，涵盖考试成绩、缺勤率及违纪事件。值得注意的是，现有疫情研究大多仅覆盖至2022-23学年的缺勤数据，且关于疫情后学生违纪行为发生率的量化证据极为有限。与既往研究一致，我们发现疫情对考试成绩存在持续性负面影响，且考试成绩在种族与族裔维度上呈现显著差异。在中学阶段，我们还发现疫情后严重违纪事件总体发生率以及种族与族裔间严重违纪事件差异均持续扩大。然而，到2024-25学年，出勤率与长期缺勤率方面的种族与族裔差异已出现显著恢复。就所有结果而言，差异扩大的主要原因是黑人与拉丁裔学生就读的学校在疫情前已存在更差的表现，且这些学校中经济弱势或面临学习障碍的学生比例在疫情前就更高。

title: Do China's State‐Owned Enterprises Promote Their Suppliers' Participation in Global Value Chains?
title_zh: 中国国有企业是否促进了其供应商参与全球价值链？
title_primary: 中国国有企业是否促进了其供应商参与全球价值链？
title_secondary: Do China's State‐Owned Enterprises Promote Their Suppliers' Participation in Global Value Chains?
official: 官方在线 2026-07-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Chinese state‐owned enterprises (SOEs) serve as critical institutional anchors in supply chains. Utilising panel data from 1076 Chinese A‐share listed firms during the period of 2008–2016, this study examines the impact of SOEs on global value chain (GVC) participation of their suppliers. The empirical results from difference‐in‐differences method demonstrate that SOEs significantly enhance their suppliers' GVC participation. Mechanism tests reveal that SOEs boost their suppliers' GVC participation through operational enhancements, supply chain efficiency and FDI attraction improvements. In addition, this study identifies that resource misallocation and coordination costs negatively moderate the effect of SOEs on their suppliers' GVC participation. Heterogeneity analyses reveal that the positive effects of SOEs are stronger for large suppliers and those suppliers without micro and small enterprises (MSEs) as major customers. Notably, SOEs enhance the intensive‐margin of GVCs but have a negligible effect on the extensive‐margin. These findings position SOEs as catalysts for GVC participation, offering policy insights for other economies with SOEs.
abstract_zh: 中国国有企业在供应链中扮演着关键的制度锚点角色。本研究利用2008-2016年间1076家中国A股上市公司的面板数据，考察国有企业对其供应商全球价值链参与度的影响。基于双重差分法的实证结果表明，国有企业显著提升了其供应商的全球价值链参与度。机制检验显示，国有企业通过运营优化、供应链效率提升以及外商直接投资吸引力增强等途径，促进了供应商的全球价值链参与。此外，本研究发现资源错配与协调成本会负向调节国有企业对供应商全球价值链参与度的促进作用。异质性分析表明，对于大型供应商以及不以微型和小型企业为主要客户的供应商而言，国有企业的正向效应更为显著。值得注意的是，国有企业主要强化了全球价值链的集约边际，而对扩展边际的影响微乎其微。这些发现将国有企业定位为全球价值链参与的催化剂，为其他拥有国有企业的经济体提供了政策启示。

title: The Life Cycle Implications of Temporary Employment Contracts
title_zh: 临时雇佣合同的生命周期影响
title_primary: 临时雇佣合同的生命周期影响
title_secondary: The Life Cycle Implications of Temporary Employment Contracts
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Employment protections often create two-tiered labor markets with substantial differences in job security. I estimate the effects of removing these protections using a quantitative life cycle model, where younger workers are more likely to select into precarious jobs. Workers accumulate human capital when employed and face the possibility of human capital losses in unemployment. Because workers with greater job security experience fewer unemployment spells, they tend to accumulate more human capital over their careers. I show that reducing employment protections boosts younger workers’ job-finding rates but lowers human capital, GDP, and employment. Impacts of these policies differ significantly by age. (JEL D15, E23, E24, J22, J24, J41, J42)
abstract_zh: 就业保护往往导致劳动力市场出现两级分化，不同岗位的工作保障程度差异显著。本文通过构建量化生命周期模型，评估了取消这些保护措施的经济效应。在该模型中，年轻劳动者更倾向于选择不稳定的工作岗位。劳动者在就业期间积累人力资本，而失业则面临人力资本贬损的风险。由于工作保障程度较高的劳动者经历失业的次数更少，其职业生涯中积累的人力资本往往更多。研究表明：降低就业保护虽能提升年轻劳动者的就业率，但会降低人力资本存量、国内生产总值及整体就业水平。这些政策对不同年龄段劳动者的影响存在显著差异。（JEL分类号：D15, E23, E24, J22, J24, J41, J42）

title: Costly Bayesian optimism
title_zh: 昂贵的贝叶斯乐观主义
title_primary: 昂贵的贝叶斯乐观主义
title_secondary: Costly Bayesian optimism
official: 官方在线 2026-06-27 · 来源：RSS
abstract: People often deviate from Bayesian updating by processing information in an optimistic manner. In such optimistic information processing, people tend to selectively incorporate information that is favorable to them. Furthermore, it is known that such selective belief updating imposes psychological costs on them. In this paper, we model optimistic belief updating with psychological costs and provide axiomatic foundations for it. Our model includes Bayesian updating as a special case while allowing for a unified axiomatization of various forms of optimistic information processing by modifying certain axioms.
abstract_zh: 人们往往通过乐观的方式处理信息，从而偏离贝叶斯更新。在这种乐观的信息处理过程中，人们倾向于有选择地吸收对自己有利的信息。此外，已知这种选择性信念更新会给他们带来心理成本。在本文中，我们构建了带有心理成本的乐观信念更新模型，并为其提供了公理化基础。我们的模型将贝叶斯更新作为特例包含在内，同时通过修改某些公理，实现了对各种乐观信息处理形式的统一公理化。

title: Getting There and Getting In: How Mobility and Sorting Keep Women out of Top Startup Accelerators
title_zh: 到达与进入：流动性与分类如何将女性排除在顶级创业加速器之外
title_primary: 到达与进入：流动性与分类如何将女性排除在顶级创业加速器之外
title_secondary: Getting There and Getting In: How Mobility and Sorting Keep Women out of Top Startup Accelerators
authors: Chuan Chen, Michele Fioretti, Junnan He, Yanrong Jia
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Startup accelerators are a leading gateway to venture capital, but top programs often require founders to relocate to a venture hub. From a hand-collected census of U.S. accelerator startups (2008-2011) followed for five years, we estimate a two-sided matching model that separates two channels behind the gender funding gap, geographic mobility and sorting across accelerator tiers. Women raise about 60% less than men over five years; the gap concentrates among non-relocating women, is largest at active-childrearing ages, and vanishes for relocators, while the mobility cost is near zero for men. Removing mobility frictions raises women's match quality but not their tier; reaching the high-funding top tier also requires removing the sorting disadvantage that women face. The 2012 JOBS Act eased the legal barrier and capacity grew tenfold, yet the U.S. VC dollar gap still tripled (2011-2020): closing it needs mobility, sorting, and capacity together.
abstract_zh: 创业加速器是通往风险资本的主要门户，但顶级项目通常要求创始人迁至创业中心。基于一项手工收集的美国加速器初创企业普查数据（2008-2011年，追踪五年），我们估计了一个双边匹配模型，以分离性别融资差距背后的两个渠道：地理流动性和加速器层级的分类效应。五年间，女性融资额比男性低约60%；这一差距集中在未迁址的女性群体中，在育儿活跃年龄段最大，而迁址女性的差距消失，同时男性的流动性成本几乎为零。消除流动性摩擦可提高女性的匹配质量，但无法提升其层级；要进入高融资的顶级层级，还需消除女性面临的分类劣势。2012年《创业企业扶助法》降低了法律障碍，加速器容量增长了十倍，但美国风险资本美元差距仍扩大了两倍（2011-2020年）：缩小这一差距需要同时解决流动性、分类和容量问题。

title: Pretend or Amend? On Evergreening in CRE
title_zh: 联邦储备系统理事会
title_primary: 联邦储备系统理事会
title_secondary: Pretend or Amend? On Evergreening in CRE
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Loan modifications can either amplify or mitigate credit losses depending on the strategy lenders employ. Using detailed supervisory data and a model incorporating various frictions that could encourage modifications (liquidity constraints, foreclosure costs, and loss recognition costs), I assess why banks extend CRE loans. I find that extensions predominantly address temporary payment frictions, both in normal times and following the Spring 2023 bank stress episode. Contrary to concerns about banks “extending-and-pretending” following that episode, banks increased income and principal paydown requirements for extensions, contributing to strong ex-post performance for extended loans.
abstract_zh: 贷款修改可能放大或减轻信用损失，具体取决于贷款机构采用的策略。利用详细的监管数据以及一个纳入可能促使修改的各种摩擦因素（流动性约束、止赎成本和损失确认成本）的模型，我评估了银行发放商业房地产贷款的原因。我发现，无论是在正常时期还是在2023年春季银行压力事件之后，展期主要都是为了解决临时性支付摩擦。与对该事件后银行“展期并假装”的担忧相反，银行提高了展期贷款的收入和本金偿还要求，从而使得展期贷款在事后表现出强劲的业绩。

title: Algorithmic Cooperation: A Comparison with Human Play in the Infinitely Repeated Prisoner’s Dilemma
title_zh: 算法合作：与人类在无限重复囚徒困境中的行为比较
title_primary: 算法合作：与人类在无限重复囚徒困境中的行为比较
title_secondary: Algorithmic Cooperation: A Comparison with Human Play in the Infinitely Repeated Prisoner’s Dilemma
authors: Bernhard Kasberger, Simon Martin, Hans-Theo Normann, Tobias Werner
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-06 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Reinforcement learning algorithms play an increasingly important role in economic situations. These situations are often strategic, and the artificial intelligence may or may not be cooperative. We compare human and algorithmic cooperation rates in the infinitely repeated two-player prisoner’s dilemma and study which strategies they choose to cooperate and punish deviations. Through a sequence of computational Q-learning and human-player experiments, we find that our Q-learning algorithms tend to cooperate less than humans, particularly when cooperation is risky or not incentive-compatible. Algorithms often use different strategies than humans, leading to distinct on- and off-path behavior.
abstract_zh: 强化学习算法在经济情境中扮演着日益重要的角色。这些情境往往具有策略性，而人工智能可能合作也可能不合作。我们比较了人类与算法在无限重复的两玩家囚徒困境中的合作率，并研究了它们选择何种策略进行合作及惩罚偏离行为。通过一系列计算性Q学习算法和人类玩家实验，我们发现我们的Q学习算法倾向于比人类更少合作，尤其是在合作具有风险或不符合激励相容条件时。算法常采用与人类不同的策略，导致路径上及路径外的行为存在显著差异。

title: Thematic Concentration and Mutual Fund Performance
title_zh: 主题集中度与共同基金业绩
title_primary: 主题集中度与共同基金业绩

authors: John (Jianqiu) Bai, Yuehua Tang, Chi Wan, Zafer Yuksel
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study examines whether mutual fund managers generate alpha through thematic investment strategies that select stocks poised to benefit from specific themes. Using textual analysis of 10-K filings, we identify stocks’ thematic exposures and construct each fund’s thematic concentration index (TCI) from its holdings. High-TCI funds significantly outperform, with a top-minus-bottom decile spread of 4.26% in annualized four-factor alpha. Managers’ thematic expertise is related to their undergraduate field of study. Outperformance arises from superior stock selection rather than theme-related timing, with an informational advantage on firm earnings, particularly in stocks exposed to themes related to managers’ undergraduate training.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了共同基金经理是否通过主题投资策略（即选择有望从特定主题中受益的股票）创造超额收益。通过对10-K文件进行文本分析，我们识别出股票的主题暴露程度，并根据基金持仓构建了各基金的主题集中指数（TCI）。高TCI基金的表现显著优于其他基金，其最高与最低十分位组合的年化四因子阿尔法差值为4.26%。基金经理的主题专长与其本科专业领域相关。超额收益源于卓越的选股能力而非主题相关时机选择，且这种优势体现在对公司盈利的信息优势上，尤其当股票暴露的主题与基金经理本科专业背景相关时更为显著。

title: Governments’ home bias and efficiency losses: Evidence from national and subnational governments
title_zh: 政府本土偏好与效率损失：来自国家及地方政府的证据
title_primary: 政府本土偏好与效率损失：来自国家及地方政府的证据

abstract: Using one million procurement contracts awarded in France and Spain, we quantify the importance of home bias in explaining governments’ purchases. First, we exploit that “home” has a different meaning for subnational and national governments and identify their relative home bias by comparing how local and non-local establishments sell to national and subnational agencies within a region. Second, we exploit a reorganization of French regions, to estimate how “new local” establishments sell to governments after the reform. Using a quantitative trade model, we find that governments’ home bias increases local expenditures shares by 29% and reduces governments’ output by 8%.
abstract_zh: 利用法国和西班牙授予的一百万份采购合同，我们量化了本土偏好对政府购买行为的重要性。首先，我们利用“本土”对次国家级和国家级政府的不同含义，通过比较区域内本地与非本地企业向国家和次国家级机构销售的情况，识别出它们的相对本土偏好。其次，我们利用法国地区的重组，估计了改革后“新本地”企业如何向政府销售。借助定量贸易模型，我们发现政府的本土偏好使本地支出份额增加了29%，同时使政府产出减少了8%。

abstract: This paper examines the effects of monetary policy in a small open economy participating in the global value chains by constructing a model with firm heterogeneity and production fragmentation. Liquidity constraints and terms‐of‐trade externality distort the sorting of firms into different operations. Under a flexible exchange‐rate regime, changes in domestic interest rate can affect the distribution of firms across different trade modes, the economy's processing and ordinary trade flows, and economic welfare. The presence of processing trade is shown to alter the monetary policy trade‐off. When the domestic interest rate is the only policy instrument available, the second‐best optimal interest rate will be zero (positive) in the case with a sufficiently low (high) output elasticity of imported input in the production of final‐good export. The ability of the Friedman rule to address the distortions from the terms‐of‐trade externality hinges on the relatively higher labour intensity in processing than in ordinary production.
abstract_zh: 本文通过构建一个包含企业异质性与生产碎片化的模型，考察了参与全球价值链的小型开放经济体中的货币政策效应。流动性约束与贸易条件外部性扭曲了企业进入不同运营模式的选择。在灵活汇率制度下，国内利率变动能够影响企业跨不同贸易模式的分布、经济的加工贸易与一般贸易流量，以及经济福利。研究表明，加工贸易的存在会改变货币政策的权衡关系。当国内利率是唯一可用的政策工具时，在最终品出口生产中进口投入的产出弹性足够低（高）的情况下，次优最优利率将为零（正）。弗里德曼规则能否纠正贸易条件外部性带来的扭曲，取决于加工生产相对于一般生产具有较高的劳动密集度。

title: Existence and calculation of optimal monetary equilibria on overlapping generations economies
title_zh: 重叠世代经济中最优货币均衡的存在性与计算
title_primary: 重叠世代经济中最优货币均衡的存在性与计算
title_secondary: Existence and calculation of optimal monetary equilibria on overlapping generations economies
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-09 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: A well-known feature of overlapping generations economies is that the First Welfare Theorem fails and equilibrium may be inefficient. The Cass (1972) criterion furnishes a necessary and sufficient condition for efficiency, but it does not address the existence of efficient equilibria, and Cass, Okuno, and Zilcha (1979) provide nonexistence examples. A closely related question (known as the Hahn (1965) problem) deals with the existence of monetary equilibria. In this paper, I provide sufficient conditions for the existence of optimal monetary equilibria on consumption-loan, non-stationary overlapping generations economies without durable, dividend-paying assets, cash-in-advance constraints, wealth-transfer mechanisms, or transaction costs. Essentially, the economy must be prone to savings. Furthermore, I develop an algorithm to find these optimal monetary equilibria as the limit of nested compact sets. These compact sets are the result of a backward calculation through equilibrium equations departing from the set of optimal monetary equilibria of well-behaved tail economies.
abstract_zh: 重叠世代经济的一个众所周知特征是，第一福利定理失效，均衡可能无效率。Cass（1972）准则提供了效率的充分必要条件，但并未涉及有效均衡的存在性，而Cass、Okuno和Zilcha（1979）给出了不存在性的例子。一个密切相关的问题（即Hahn（1965）问题）涉及货币均衡的存在性。在本文中，我为消费贷款型、非平稳重叠世代经济中最优货币均衡的存在性提供了充分条件，这些经济不包含耐用品、分红资产、现金预付约束、财富转移机制或交易成本。本质上，经济必须倾向于储蓄。此外，我开发了一种算法，通过嵌套紧集极限来寻找这些最优货币均衡。这些紧集是通过从表现良好的尾部经济的最优货币均衡集合出发，沿均衡方程进行反向计算得出的结果。

abstract: We examine a controlled school choice model in which students are divided into types and the distribution of admitted students influences schools’ priority structures. We introduce a general class of priority rules that represent priorities as weak orders (allowing ties) for each given assignment and satisfy three axioms: Preference for Diversity, Within-Type Ordering, and Distributional Consistency. This framework includes the adjusted scoring rule, which flexibly integrates reserves, quotas, and bonus-point rules while accounting for uncertainty in applicants’ types and scores. From such priority profiles, we construct choice functions that satisfy substitutability and size monotonicity. We show that the student-proposing deferred acceptance mechanism with these functions yields matchings that are stable with respect to the original priority profiles and satisfy group strategy-proofness. Moreover, when priority profiles are restricted to linear orders for each given assignment, our mechanism yields a student-optimal stable matching.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个受控学校选择模型，其中学生被划分为不同类型，且录取学生的分布会影响学校的优先结构。我们引入了一类通用的优先规则，这些规则将优先权表示为针对每个给定分配的弱序（允许并列），并满足三个公理：多样性偏好、类型内排序和分布一致性。该框架包括调整后的评分规则，该规则灵活整合了预留名额、配额和加分规则，同时考虑了申请者类型和分数的不确定性。基于此类优先概况，我们构建了满足可替代性和规模单调性的选择函数。我们证明，采用这些函数的学生提议延迟接受机制能够产生相对于原始优先概况稳定的匹配，并满足群体策略证明性。此外，当优先概况被限制为每个给定分配的线性序时，我们的机制能够产生学生最优的稳定匹配。

abstract: In Raised to Obey, Agustina Paglayan challenges conventional interpretations of the spread of mass education since the late eighteenth century, which have been based – particularly within economic history – on arguments such as increased returns to human capital due to industrialization and growing democratization. Instead, the book defends a political-economy argument according to which elites expanded schooling not primarily to foster growth or equality but to contain social unrest and inculcate obedience among potentially rebellious populations. Mass education emerged as a substitute for repression: an investment in social order that, in the long run, would be less costly and more sustainable than mere coercion – a thesis that, in different forms, has long been debated, not least within economics (Bowles and Gintis 1976). The scope of the book is impressive. Drawing on a wide range of historical and quantitative evidence, Paglayan traces the expansion of primary education across Europe and the Americas from the late eighteenth century onwards, combining cross-country analysis with detailed case studies, such as those of Britain, France, and Chile, among others. Although the argument is not original per se, the core contribution of the book is providing compelling evidence that conflict and elite fear played the most important role in the long-term diffusion of mass education and literacy – at least for Europe and Latin America, questioning the assumption that schooling was designed to empower citizens or enhance productivity. The book is an excellent read for academics and policymakers alike and provides a lot of food for thought concerning historical education and its relationship with society and the economy. Interestingly, the book looks at the history of education to question today's educational practices across countries. Are present-day education systems, which arose from the attempt of nineteenth-century elites to control potentially threatening populations, the best way to really stimulate democratization, free thinking, and the growth of useful knowledge? While this question remains valid, Paglayan's reinterpretation of the historical factors that sustained mass education sits uneasily with parts of the existing scholarly literature. The core argument of the book seems to rest on the implicit assumption that education was mainly a state-level phenomenon and that national education acts passed by the central government exerted an immediate (and homogeneous) impact across all regions and social strata within the same country. Indeed, the most used indicator to capture central governments acting to improve primary education is whether they have passed a national school law. Yet, recent evidence, particularly on countries that are not discussed within the book, such as Italy (Cappelli and Vasta 2020) and Spain (Beltrán Tapia and Martinez-Galarraga 2018), shows that national legislation concerning primary schooling was likely ineffective in fostering education alone, which was primarily due to the way the primary-school system was designed, that is, as primarily decentralized. The government set the rules of the game, but local authorities implemented them (p. 108) – the extent of which depended on local democratization, fiscal and administrative capacity, inequality, and existing schooling rates, among the others. Paglayan's claim that administrative form (centralization versus decentralization) does not matter for her argument (p. 118) is not fully convincing, particularly considering known historical variations across Europe (Westberg 2020). Another broad concern is the treatment of confounding factors in the quantitative sections. For example, changes in the trends of enrolment rates are interpreted as responses to unrest (p. 79), yet alternative explanations – such as economic performance or state capacity – receive more limited attention. Similarly, though wars (external conflict) are mentioned in the book, their potential state-building implications are not fully integrated into the analytical framework. This may be problematic, as warfare has long been central to explanations of the expansion in fiscal capacity (Dincecco et al. 2011; Sabaté 2016). A related issue concerns some of the variables used to capture structural change in phenomena potentially associated with education. Industrialization is measured using broad indicators (p. 66), while the diffusion of education is proxied by the passage of national education legislation – as mentioned earlier. One may argue that these measures do not always capture the underlying phenomena convincingly, particularly given recent work showing the importance of gradual, locally driven schooling expansion (see above), as well as existing estimates of industrial value-added and/or per-capita GDP figures across most of the countries included in the book's analyses. Indeed, one may argue, economic growth might pull the expansion of education through the service sector, too, or even when new technologies are introduced within the primary sector. The book's empirical strategy is more convincing in some contexts than in others. The analysis of Chile, particularly the Atacama rebellion, stands out as a compelling case in which a clear core–periphery conflict aligns well with the theory. By contrast, evidence from Europe would benefit from replication using alternative datasets. Recent work, including Adrien Montalbo's research on nineteenth-century France, suggests that there is more to the expansion of mass education than just a disciplinary channel, including demand for education fostered by industrialization (Montalbo 2020). The discussion of nineteenth-century Britain and, differently, Sweden and France, further illustrates some of these issues and brings about others. Paglayan notes that around 1850 Britain exhibited relatively low enrolment ratios compared with continental Europe (pp. 62–63). Yet, for matters of human capital accumulation, literacy – regardless of how it was acquired – arguably matters more than formal enrolment. On this metric, Britain does not appear particularly backward. England and Wales displayed the highest literacy rates among European regions in the second half of the nineteenth century (Mitch 1984), and gross enrolment rates did not lag much behind those of Central and Northern Europe (Cappelli, Ridolfi, Vasta, and Westberg 2025). The book also tends to interpret curricular differentiation between urban and rural areas as a deliberate strategy to immobilize rural populations (p. 68). While this may be consistent with the core argument of the book, an alternative interpretation is that simplified rural curricula lowered barriers to entry, allowing basic schooling to take root where resources and demand were limited, as it seems to have been the case in nineteenth-century Sweden (Westberg 2022). The French case also exposes some tensions in the core thesis. Paglayan shows how elites oscillated between repression and educational investment in response to rural unrest (p. 139). Yet, early primary education itself involved some forms of coercion, such as compulsory attendance, linguistic standardization, and moral discipline, that may not have been perceived as fundamentally different from other instruments of state power. Moreover, the long and uncertain horizon of educational returns complicates the notion that schooling was a clearly superior alternative to repression from the perspective of national and/or local elites. Raised to Obey is an important and stimulating book. It forces historians and political economists alike to confront uncomfortable questions about the political purposes of schooling and the relationship between education and power – potentially making room for future empirical studies on the matter that adopt a historical perspective. The book succeeds in broadening the debate and in challenging complacent narratives of education as an unambiguous public good. It will be widely read and discussed, and rightly so.
abstract_zh: 在《被培养成服从》一书中，奥古斯蒂娜·帕格莱安挑战了自十八世纪末以来关于大众教育普及的传统解释，这些解释——尤其是在经济史领域——基于诸如工业化带来的人力资本回报增加以及日益增长的民主化等论点。相反，该书捍卫了一种政治经济学论点，即精英阶层扩展教育并非主要为了促进增长或平等，而是为了遏制社会动荡，并在潜在的反叛人群中灌输服从意识。大众教育作为镇压的替代品出现：一种对社会秩序的投资，从长远来看，其成本更低、比单纯的强制手段更具可持续性——这一论点以不同形式长期受到辩论，尤其是在经济学界（鲍尔斯和金蒂斯，1976年）。本书的覆盖面令人印象深刻。借助广泛的历史和定量证据，帕格莱安追溯了自十八世纪末以来欧洲和美洲初等教育的扩展，将跨国分析与详细案例研究相结合，如英国、法国和智利等。尽管这一论点本身并非原创，但本书的核心贡献在于提供了令人信服的证据，表明冲突和精英的恐惧在长期大众教育和识字率的普及中发挥了最重要的作用——至少对欧洲和拉丁美洲而言，从而质疑了教育旨在赋权公民或提高生产力的假设。本书对学者和政策制定者而言都是一本极佳的读物，为历史教育及其与社会经济的关系提供了大量思考素材。有趣的是，本书通过审视教育历史来质疑当今各国的教育实践。当今的教育体系源于十九世纪精英阶层控制潜在威胁人群的尝试，它是否是真正促进民主化、自由思考和有用知识增长的最佳途径？尽管这一问题仍然有效，但帕格莱安对支撑大众教育的历史因素的重新解读，与现有学术文献的部分内容并不完全吻合。本书的核心论点似乎隐含着一个假设，即教育主要是一种国家层面的现象，中央政府通过的国家教育法案在全国所有地区和社会阶层中产生了即时（且同质）的影响。事实上，用于衡量中央政府推动初等教育行动的最常用指标是是否通过了国家学校法。然而，最近的证据，特别是针对本书未涉及的国家，如意大利（卡佩利和瓦斯塔，2020年）和西班牙（贝尔特兰·塔皮亚和马丁内斯-加拉拉加，2018年），表明关于初等教育的国家立法本身可能无法有效促进教育发展，这主要是由于初等学校体系的设计方式，即主要采取分权模式。政府制定了游戏规则，但由地方当局执行（第108页）——其执行程度取决于地方民主化、财政和行政能力、不平等状况以及现有入学率等因素。帕格莱安声称行政形式（集权与分权）对其论点无关紧要（第118页），这一说法并不完全令人信服，尤其是考虑到欧洲已知的历史差异（韦斯特伯格，2020年）。另一个广泛关注的问题是在定量部分对混杂因素的处理。例如，入学率趋势的变化被解释为对社会动荡的回应（第79页），而其他替代解释——如经济表现或国家能力——则受到较少的关注。同样，尽管书中提到了战争（外部冲突），但其潜在的国家建设意义并未完全纳入分析框架。这可能存在问题，因为战争长期以来一直是财政能力扩张解释的核心（丁切科等人，2011年；萨巴特，2016年）。一个相关问题涉及用于捕捉可能与教育相关现象的结构性变化的某些变量。工业化使用宽泛指标来衡量（第66页），而教育的普及则通过国家教育立法的通过来代理——如前所述。有人可能会认为，这些衡量标准并不总能令人信服地捕捉潜在现象，特别是考虑到最近的研究表明渐进式、地方驱动的教育扩展的重要性（见上文），以及本书分析中涵盖的大多数国家现有的工业增加值或人均GDP估计数据。事实上，有人可能会认为，经济增长也可能通过服务业拉动教育扩展，甚至当新技术在初级部门引入时也是如此。本书的实证策略在某些情境下比其他情境更具说服力。对智利的分析，特别是阿塔卡马叛乱，作为一个引人注目的案例脱颖而出，其中清晰的核心-边缘冲突与理论高度契合。相比之下，来自欧洲的证据将受益于使用替代数据集进行复制。最近的研究，包括阿德里安·蒙塔尔博对十九世纪法国的研究，表明大众教育的扩展不仅仅是纪律渠道，还包括工业化促进的教育需求（蒙塔尔博，2020年）。对十九世纪英国以及不同情况下的瑞典和法国的讨论进一步说明了其中一些问题，并引发了其他问题。帕格莱安指出，大约在1850年，英国的入学率相对于欧洲大陆较低（第62-63页）。然而，就人力资本积累而言，识字率——无论其获取方式如何——可以说比正式入学更为重要。在这一指标上，英国并不显得特别落后。在十九世纪下半叶，英格兰和威尔士的识字率在欧洲各地区中最高（米奇，1984年），毛入学率也不比中欧和北欧落后多少（卡佩利、里多尔菲、瓦斯塔和韦斯特伯格，2025年）。本书还倾向于将城市和农村地区课程设置的差异解释为一种故意使农村人口固化的策略（第68页）。虽然这可能与本书的核心论点一致，但另一种解释是，简化的农村课程降低了入学门槛，使基础学校在资源和需求有限的地区得以扎根，这似乎是十九世纪瑞典的情况（韦斯特伯格，2022年）。法国案例也暴露了核心论点中的一些紧张关系。帕格莱安展示了精英阶层如何根据农村动荡在镇压和教育投资之间摇摆（第139页）。然而，早期初等教育本身涉及某种形式的强制，如强制入学、语言标准化和道德纪律，这些可能并未被视为与国家权力的其他工具根本不同。此外，教育回报的长期且不确定的时间跨度，使得从国家和地方精英的角度来看，教育是否明显优于镇压这一观点变得复杂。《被培养成服从》是一本重要且引人深思的书。它迫使历史学家和政治经济学家面对关于学校教育的政治目的以及教育与权力之间关系的令人不安的问题——可能为未来采用历史视角的实证研究留出空间。本书成功地拓宽了辩论范围，并挑战了将教育视为明确公共物品的自满叙事。它将被广泛阅读和讨论，这是理所当然的。
